requirements.statement: The upgrade audit partitions every relevant docs/KEEL_UPGRADES.md source section exactly once as an executable requirement, contextual/strategic material, superseded material, or justified deferred/out-of-scope material, with status, evidence, and workstream ownership where unresolved.

The active upgrade roadmap requires every future authorized workstream ExecPlan to include complete implementation and verification safety fields, while preserving P0–P7, D1 deferral, dependency boundaries, and blockers.
The remediation changes only planning/documentation artifacts and its KEEL ledger; it does not instantiate or implement P0.
